summary: Fixes SqlUtil.filterOperatorRoutinesByKind to map the requested SqlKind through getFunctionKind() as well, so an operator whose kind is remapped (POSITION, CHAR_LENGTH) still matches itself when two candidates share a name.

tests.evidence: Bug fix; regression test chains SqlStdOperatorTable with itself and validates position/char_length/character_length, which fails without the fix.

user_docs.evidence: Internal lookup fix; no documented behavior changes.

doc_comments.evidence: mihaibudiu: 'this comment could be shorter' on SqlUtil and 'this comment is too long; please do not submit useless comments' on the test; both were cut in the follow-up commit 'Shorten comments per review comments'.

change_description.evidence: PR title is truncated with an ellipsis and the commit subject is overlong; mihaibudiu: 'Your commit message should be as long as the PR title'; the PR was resubmitted as #5197.

performance.evidence: Hoists one call out of the filter; no hot-path concern.

backward_compat.evidence: Operator lookup now accepts calls it wrongly rejected; kinds mapped to OTHER_FUNCTION now match each other in the fourth pass.

error_model.evidence: Removes a spurious 'No match found' error; no error path added.

correctness.evidence: One-line symmetric mapping in SqlUtil.java:519; a quick check that widening the match for OTHER_FUNCTION-mapped kinds does not select a wrong overload is enough.

contradictions.evidence: Comments and description agree with the code; only length was an issue.

plan.why: One-line fix plus a test; one reviewer can cover the code and the prose.
